reviews.text: Excellent service, they give advice on anything you ask and are very helpful! Thank you for the tips for our kitten. Hugs

Hello, I brought my black cat Cuco to have his nails cut and the treatment was terrible and unprofessional. The woman who runs the store opened the door behind me and I didn't like the treatment I received. She only cut the front nails. Obviously I won't be back again.
Excellent service, and the products are great too. I have a toy rabbit, and they have all the products I need at good prices.
They have almost everything you could need if you have a dog. Excellent service.

I went there to do a CPNL language internship, the girls who will assist me are very nice and fun, the store is well organized and you can ask without any problem about products and toys for your pets.
The service is always attentive and friendly. The sales assistants are always ready to help and offer advice. There's a wide variety of high-quality products. A highly recommended neighborhood shop.

100% recommended
Very good service and if you have any questions, they will solve them right away

This shop is a delight, it's a pleasure to go in. They have a huge variety of products, the staff are incredibly friendly, you can tell they know their products and are passionate about our animals. Esteban is such a lovely person and a true professional! You can tell he treats our furry friends as if they were his own. You're a fantastic team!!! 💖
A neighborhood pet store with great products. You'll find everything you need here.

Varied assortment and with all kinds of prices. For my cat they had what I was looking for. They took great care of me. Too bad I don't live in the neighborhood, but if I can, I will definitely come back!

WE LOVE THIS STORE!!

Personalized service, the staff are super professional and empathetic.

Their products are high quality and the prices are excellent!
They have a loyalty program and offer discounts.

They're always happy to help with any questions!

Thank you so much, loves ♥️
